description.narrative: DGAP will create the Eastern Partnership Think-Tank Forum, a sustainable as well as inclusive analysis and debate platform for think tanks working on the Eastern Partnership (EaP) in the EU, in the EaP countries, and beyond. Identifying critical issues for the next phase of the Eastern Partnership policy after the physical EaP summit and advising the Commission. Raising knowledge of the Eastern Partnership policy within the EU and the EaP.
